points: Announced for the Invest in Germany Summit in Berlin, 19-20 October 2026
Focus: robotics, industrial manufacturing and autonomous driving
Expected partners include Siemens, Audi and Black Forest Labs; no amount stated by the government
take: Berlin is backing Nvidia as the platform for robotics and factory AI, with about a dozen German firms. A signal for vendor choice in industrial AI; funding and terms not yet public.
title: German government: Merz and Nvidia to launch industrial AI partnership
